classFeature.name: Spellcasting
entries: As a student of arcane magic, you have learned to cast spells.

classFeature.name: Arcane Recovery
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can recover expended spell slots.

classFeature.name: Scholar
entries: You gain Expertise in one of these skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion.

classFeature.name: Wizard Subclass
entries: You gain a Wizard subclass of your choice.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another feat of your choice.

classFeature.name: Memorize Spell
entries: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can swap one prepared spell.

subclassFeature.name: Evoker
entries: You focus your study on magic that creates powerful elemental effects.

subclassFeature.name: Evocation Savant
entries: Choose two Wizard spells from the Evocation school and add them to your spellbook for free.

subclassFeature.name: Potent Cantrip
entries: Your damaging cantrips affect even creatures that avoid the brunt of the effect.

subclassFeature.name: Sculpt Spells
entries: You can create pockets of relative safety within the effects of your evocations.
